┌─ Help: Logs and replay ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Logs and replay                                                              │
│   Every session is recorded by default, under its id, in seq-tui/sessions in │
│   your data dir (-log-dir moves it, -no-record turns it off). A log never    │
│   holds your credential.                                                     │
│   Ctrl+L lists your sessions, yours and the server's log of them: Enter      │
│   replays one in place (Left and Right step, Home and End jump, Esc comes    │
│   back), R reads the server's log, E exports one to a file.                  │
│   seq-tui -replay FILE (or a session id) draws a recording with no server;   │
│   -text prints it as plain text.                                             │
│   V shows more of the event log: routine movement and rules ticks.           │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
